title: fix(console): after a sign-out, the next person to sign in lands on their own home, not the previous person's page

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuHF6g83xPLnHoDsxEw6wKQ6)_

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在控制台里点「退出登录」之后，登录页不再带 `?redirect=` 回到上一个人打开的页面，下一个人登录后落到自己的首页。会话过期或被吊销（不是主动退出）时仍保留原路径，同一个人重新登录后回到原处。
- 为什么改：管理员在「系统设置」页面退出后，新成员登录直接落到那个页面，看到「你没有访问此应用的权限」（卡片 item 4，main 的生产构建上已复现）。
- 风险与回滚：只改登录跳转的一个分支；退出时少带一个参数，其它跳转（邀请链接、深链接、过期）不变；回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx`（`sessionEndedBySignOut` 的升起与落下）、`ui/apps/console/src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx` 的 `LoginRedirect`、测试文件 `ProtectedRoute.signOutListState-29174.test.tsx` 新增的 objectstack#30125 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/ProtectedRoute.signOutListState-29174.test.tsx`，预期 7 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Card #30125, **item 4**: after a sign-out, the next person lands on the previous person's page.

- **`@object-ui/auth`**: `AuthContextValue.sessionEndedBySignOut` (new, boolean). `AuthProvider.signOut()` raises it in the same batch that clears `user`/`session`, so the first render without a session already reads it; it is lowered during render as soon as a session exists again, whoever it belongs to. A session that ends any other way (`loadSession` re-resolving to nothing: expiry, revocation, a sign-out in another tab) leaves it `false`. The outside-provider default in `useAuth.ts` answers `false`.
- **`@object-ui/console`**: `LoginRedirect` sends the visitor to `/login` with no `?redirect=` when `sessionEndedBySignOut` is true. Otherwise it is unchanged: the path and params are kept, list `uf_*` state stripped (#29174).
- All three sign-out call sites (`AppHeader`, `UserMenu`, `RemediationOverlay`) go through `AuthProvider.signOut()`, so the change is at that one source; `AppHeader.tsx` is not touched.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/30125-sign-out-no-return-link.md`, `@object-ui/auth` and `@object-ui/console` patch.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-guv7bd`, not `claude/issue-30125-*`; the card is #30125.

## Tests

In the existing harness file `ProtectedRoute.signOutListState-29174.test.tsx` (real `AuthProvider` over a scripted client, real `ProtectedRoute`, real Console `LoginPage`), a new top-level describe for #30125, 3 cases:

- A signs out of a Setup page; the login URL is exactly `/login`, no `redirect`; B signs in and lands on `/`.
- A's session expires on the same page (the provider's own `refreshSession` re-resolves to no session); the login URL keeps the path; A signs back in and lands on it.
- The sign-out is forgotten once someone signs in: A signs out, B signs in in the same tab, B's session then expires on the page, and the path is kept again.

The #29174 block's first case now ends A's session by **expiry** instead of by sign-out: an explicit sign-out carries no return link at all, so the list-state stripping it pins is only reachable on the expiry path. Its assertions are otherwise unchanged (moved pin, declared).

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 3 (time zone dialog over a toast): not reproduced on a production build of main, no change.** Measured with `os start` (Mode: production) on `examples/app-todo`, console built by `pnpm console:build` at `989ae42d`, Chromium 1440x900, zh-CN, Asia/Shanghai, a freshly registered first administrator. The dialog opened 0.2 to 0.3 s after the first entry into any `/apps/...` route (Setup), before any action was possible; after it was answered, inviting a member raised the invitation toast and no dialog opened over it. The prompt is mounted only under `/apps/:appName/*` and asks once per org and user, so on main it cannot first appear after an in-app action. Residual, not measured: an action OUTSIDE `/apps` that raises a toast and then navigates into an app within the toast's 4 s could still open the dialog over it; no such path was found in the first-run flow.
- Items 1, 2 and 5 are out of this PR (server and product call / held by #30157 PR #30243 / devx template) and stay on the card.
- `AuthContextValue` gains a required member. Code that builds its own value of that type (a test double typed as `AuthContextValue`) must add it; in this tree the only such builders are `useAuth.ts` (updated) and `inbox-arrival-preview.tsx`, which casts through `unknown`. Declared `Clause-②: yes (widening)` for this, as PR #29338 did for its `AuthContextValue` / `AuthClient` members.
- Two browser tabs: a sign-out in tab 1 reaches tab 2 as a session that re-resolved to nothing, so tab 2 keeps its path. That is the expiry reading, by design: this provider cannot tell who signed out over there.
